generationNotes: Implemented JUnit 4 test class RemoveDiscountCodeTest extending BaseTest in package tests.
Integrated po.PaymentPage.setDiscountCode(String) as required, and inlined Selenium interactions for add/remove buttons and price/discount elements.
Validated preconditions: verified system property 'test.discount.code' is provided and checked presence/visibility of #total-cart-amount at /checkout/payment.
Asserted total reduction, successful removal, field clearing, absence of #discount-amount, and total restoration within 0.01 delta.
assumptions: BaseTest provides a functional WebDriver instance named 'driver' initialized before test execution.
po.PaymentPage has a constructor accepting WebDriver and exposes setDiscountCode(String).
Precondition test fixture provides a published product already added to the cart so navigation to /checkout/payment renders #total-cart-amount.
The discount code supplied via System.getProperty('test.discount.code') is active and reduces the checkout total.
